name: Berserk Style
description: You are skilled at returning pain to those who deliver it. You gain the following benefits:
benefits: When you hit with a melee weapon attack using Strength, you deal additional damage equal to your Strength modifier if that creature dealt damage to you since the start of your last turn.
When you choose to let an attack that would miss you hit you instead, the creature rolls the damage as normal instead of choosing the maximum.
